The '''E5 blaster carbine''', or '''E-5 blaster carbine''', was a [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbine]] used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] throughout the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and later by criminal, paramilitary, or [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] groups during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was a shortened version of the [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1 battle droid]]'s famous [[E-5 blaster rifle/Legends|E-5 blaster rifle]] manufactured by [[Baktoid Armor Workshop/Legends|Baktoid Armor Workshop]].

==Description==
The E5 blaster carbine was a carbine version of the famed [[E-5 blaster rifle/Legends|E-5 blaster rifle]]. Like its predecessor, it was originally a [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech]] design that was reverse-engineered by [[Baktoid Armor Workshop/Legends|Baktoid Armor Workshop]] for wide use by [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]. However, contrary to the E-5 rifle, the carbine was largely intended to be used by vehicle crews and rear-echelon droids. The carbine E-5 was lighter and shorter than its rifle counterpart. Designed for mass production, the E5 family was made with substandard materials that rendered the weapon fragile and prone to overheating.<ref name="SoT" /> The fact that the weapon was intended for use by non-living wielders allowed Baktoid to skimp on some of the finer points&mdash;such as the fact that short barreled weapons were comparatively fragile and produced a great deal of heat over repeated firings.<ref name="A&EG" /> The E5 carbine also lacked precision over long distances but had a [[Stock/Legends|retractable stock]] that improved its usability.<ref name="SoT" />

==History==
The E5 carbine was introduced during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] to equip [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1]], [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX]] and [[OOM-series battle droid/Legends|OOM]] battle droids. The weapon was manufactured en masse to equip Trade Federation and later Separatist forces, and was a frequent sight in the hands of B1 battle droids, particularly among vehicle crews and special operatives.<ref name="SoT" />

[[File:LegendaryE5Carbine.jpg|250px|thumb|A "legendary" E5 carbine]]
Following the Clone Wars, huge amounts of E5 carbines were made available<ref name="SoT" /> to paramilitary units,<ref name="SWGTCG">{{SWGTCG|set=Threat of the Conqueror|cardname=E5 Carbine}}</ref> [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]],<ref name="A&EG" /> [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]],<ref name="SWG:RotW">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees]]''</ref> and cash-strapped groups such as the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. Although not held in the highest regard by its users, its high availability and its cheap price made it a common sight throughout the galaxy.<ref name="SoT" /> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], it was favored by [[Officer/Legends|officers]].<ref name="TSC">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=66930&resource=features|text=Tech Specs: Carbines}}</ref> After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], a spacer discovered a heavily-modified E5 Carbine, dubbed "legendary" E5 carbine.<ref name="SWG:H17.10">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other|Hotfix 17.10}}</ref> E5 carbines were also used by B1 battle droids [[HK-47's Droid Army|serving]] [[HK-47]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]<ref name="SWG:OR5E5" /> in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> One such weapon, [[OR-5]]'s E-5, was later found by a spacer in the [[Kubaza beetle cavern]].<ref name="SWG:RCWMII">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Rare Carbine Weapons Mark II}}</ref>

E5 blaster carbines were still used during the [[New Jedi Order]] era.<ref name="A&EG" />
